recipes.name: Peppermint Mocha
instructions: In a jar, mix the sugar, cocoa powder, instant coffee, chocolate, and peppermint*.
Mix 1½ Tbsp of the powdered mix with ¼ cup (60 mL) of boiling water in each mug and stir to dissolve.
Then add 1 cup (240 mL) hot milk per mug and stir.
Top with whipped cream, chocolate shavings, and peppermint pieces if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Finely chopped ensures they dissolve more easily in the drink. † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * Make-ahead: in the photos, we batch-made 24 servings of the powdered mix. Simply use the scaling feature to scale the recipe to your desired number of servings.
Storage The mixed drink is best enjoyed immediately. The mocha powdered mix can be kept in the mason jar s for up to 2 months.
